kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعوهدت (form VI)
# تُعُوهِدْتُ (tuʕūhidtu) /tu.ʕuː.hid.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُعُوهِدْتَ (tuʕūhidta) /tu.ʕuː.hid.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُعُوهِدْتِ (tuʕūhidti) /tu.ʕuː.hid.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُعُوهِدَتْ (tuʕūhidat) /tu.ʕuː.hi.dat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
